notes.title: What's new in version 0.2.02
notes.content:
Dear players, we continue working hard on the game and here is a small update.

What's new in version 0.2.02:
1. Adjusted paddle elasticity and ball physics
2. 5 difficulty levels instead of 3
3. Added AI opponent emotions
4. Chinese language support
5. Shorter delay between matches in Quick Match mode
6. Adjusted controllers' force feedback
7. Improved visibility of ball and table
8. Endless and Whack-a-Mole modes: Record tables have more positions and players' Steam avatars are shown there
9. New floating scoreboard
10. New winning and losing special effects
11. Rules for each mode now available in Main Menu, current match rules on scoreboard
12. Fixed bug making it difficult to toss the ball while serving

notes.title: Feedback, Suggestions and Bugs
notes.content:
Hi Pong fans,

As you know Pong It! VR is an Early Access tilte and we are open to any feedback, suggestions, bugs and so on.

No matter if it is tiny changes to the Game or a blow-everybody's-mind-feature that you are thinking about, shoot us your idea and we will figure out the rest. Follow the link to the portal where you can change the world of PongIt!


http://steamcommunity.com/app/520930/discussions/


Please leave your feedback in the top topic and we will get back to you soon!

Thanks for your interest in Pong It! VR

-Icedcoffeefan
